text_en: It was narrated from Muhammad bin Munkadir: that he heard Jabir bin 'Abdullah say: “The Jews used to say that if a man has intercourse with a woman in her vagina from the back, the child would have a squint. Then Allah, Glorious is He, revealed: 'Your wives are a tilth for you, so go to your tilth, when or how you will.' ”
text_id: Telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sahl bin Abu Sahl] dan [Jamil bin Al Hasan] keduanya berkata; telah menceritakan kepada kami [Sufyan bin Uyainah] dari [Muhammad bin Al Munkadir] bahwa ia mendengar [Jabir bin Abdullah] berkata, "Orang-orang Yahudi berkata, 'barang siapa mensetubuhi kemaluan isterinya melalui belakang, maka mata anaknya akan menjadi juling'. Lalu Allah Subhaanahu menurunkan ayat "(Isteri-isteri kalian adalah ladang kalian, maka datangilah ladang kalian dari mana engkau kehendaki)."
